name: Trey Nyoni

career_stints.note: Leicester City U18s only, not senior team, at ages 15-16. Left for Liverpool's academy in September 2023 before making any senior Leicester appearance.

Senior debut 28 Feb 2024 (FA Cup vs Southampton, aged 16, as a late substitute -- Liverpool's third-youngest ever player in the competition). Became Liverpool's youngest-ever Champions League player in January 2025 (substitute vs PSV). As of May 2025 he had made 'six appearances' for Liverpool across all competitions; a separately sourced figure for the 2025/26 Premier League season alone also states '6 appearances, 14 minutes,' which may or may not be counting the same appearances -- this ambiguity was not resolved from available sources, so the single figure of 6 is used here rather than summed, to avoid double-counting. Goals/assists at senior level: none found. Liverpool blocked a proposed loan exit in January 2026; a summer 2026 loan was under discussion as of pre-season, with Nyoni also given a chance to impress new manager Andoni Iraola.

notes: Extremely sparse senior data by design -- Nyoni is an 18-year-old academy midfielder with only a handful of senior cameo appearances (largest reported single-season Premier League sample: 14 minutes). No per-90 advanced metrics exist at a meaningful sample size; all left null rather than derived from a near-zero-minute sample.

position_estimate.basis is 'manager_overlay_adjusted' rather than 'liverpool_recent_minutes' because his actual first-team minutes are too thin to be a meaningful positional sample; the CM/DM estimate instead reflects his squad-listed positions and academy role, overlaid with an assumption about how Iraola's system would most likely use a progressive young double-pivot/8 profile if given minutes. Confidence is intentionally low (0.3).

Squad status is unresolved as of 2026-08-09 squad-file fetch: multiple mid-2026 reports describe Liverpool weighing a loan move for Nyoni for 2026/27 (Championship or European interest), with no final decision confirmed at time of writing. Worth re-checking before relying on this profile for in-season projections.

Sources: liverpoolfc.com, empireofthekop.com, rousingthekop.com, thisisanfield.com, transfermarkt.us, transferfeed.com, wikipedia.org (career-history cross-check only, not used as primary citation) -- via web search 2026-08-10.
